name: Suruga Bank Ltd.
summary: Suruga Bank Ltd. provides various banking and financial products and services to individuals and corporate customers in Japan. The company offers deposit products, such as time, non-interest bearing, savings, foreign currency, and other deposits, as well as current and general accounts; property, card, housing, second house, startup, and business up term loans, as well as loans by purpose; credit and debit cards; overdrafts; and other financing products.
